title: Project Coin Blocker
tagline: just testing uniswap hooks, with a way for project owners to restrict swaps on their token
description:
a simple uniswap hook that lets a project owner create a pool and restrict swappers to those who have interacted with their project in some meaningful way. it lets project owners block speculation on their token.
mostly just the contracts and a test, but includes a simple frontend to show the status of the pool and nft
how_its_made:
- a simple uniswap hook that lets a project owner create a pool and restrict swappers to those who have interacted with their project in some meaningful way
- the hook is written in solidity and tested with foundry
- the project is run locally with anvil against a fork of baseSepolia
-  a dummy project nft is created to check against
- a simple frontend displays the nft and pool details
